messages.content:
# Review one exact task specification

Valid completed nodes retain their original independent verification. Their execution instructions describe that historical time.
Review unfinished work and current integration. Do not reopen accepted attainment because its stock was consumed or an old instruction no longer describes today.
accepted_dependencies and historical preceding_reviews preserve that proof; original full contracts remain retrievable.
Current material provenance and final world truth have separate independent guards. Request their original sources when needed.

Return one JSON object with status, summary, and target_id.
review_scope selects one complete node contract. Its prerequisites appear in dependency_specifications and accepted_dependencies.
For a leaf, review only that leaf and its prerequisite feasibility. Other task outcomes have separate decisions.
For a story, review its complete criteria and child integration after preceding_reviews.
For the root, review the complete user goal and every integration criterion after all preceding reviews.
tree_topology describes the full durable task. Omitted node specifications remain unchanged.
Accepted dependencies record original attainment. Consumed stock need not remain in current inventory.
Historical recovery establishes an earlier prerequisite. A separate renewal establishes current safety.
Set target_id to the actual node that needs repair.
decision_scope retains paused methods and recent results. Archived last-result totals cannot prove resource provenance; full operands remain in context_archive.
Review the supplied tree independently of the planner's confidence.
When active_recovery is present, require a prerequisite-ready recovery specialist leaf with observable safety acceptance.
Recovery takes priority over optional work. Its needed tree changes can supersede an earlier optional refinement scope.
Recovery criteria describe the finished safe landing; they need not hold before ordinary escape or clearance actions.
If a placed workstation obstructs that landing, a different surveyed landing or ordinary block removal can establish safety.
Use revise for an incorrect recovery predicate that ordinary survival actions can repair. Reserve blocked for an actual external blocker.
The actor guard independently requires two safe observations and fresh supported dry geometry before recovery completion.
Recovery criteria can use alive, health, food, position, and exact blocks.
Food checks observed food against minimum on its 0..20 scale; alive checks health greater than zero only.
Health checks inclusive minimum points on the 0..20 scale. Health above 10 requires minimum=11.
Already satisfied conditions remain valid. Sufficient food belongs in safe recovery even when the active cause is low health.
For low_supplies recovery, require food minimum 7. Do not accept an alive condition described as a food check.
If the body is already dry and supported, low food requires food recovery; it does not require an escape movement.
A recovery leaf can combine the acquisition and consumption needed to resolve one hazard.
The actor cannot finish a recovery child while the hazard remains active; do not separate necessary food acquisition from consumption into dependent completion barriers.
Require acceptance conditions that cover the actual requested goal.
Read condition kinds and operands, rather than trusting their descriptions.
Region air_cells combines air, cave_air, and void_air. Use all three names for aggregate empty-cell counts, or exact block conditions for one variant.
An incomplete region needs changed coverage or exact cell checks before acceptance.
A block condition checks one cell or every listed position. It does not use end or a count threshold.
Root criteria must establish the finished outcome, including required usability facts.
Require accepted references for earlier achievements whose world facts no longer hold after dependent work.
Do not combine consumed inventory thresholds or different entry and exit positions as simultaneous final facts.
An accepted reference cites a descendant or prerequisite node with independent world evidence, never an actor claim.
References remain valid when a prerequisite leaf becomes a story with the same original criteria.
The runtime verifies that story after its children, before releasing dependent work that consumes its materials.
Require prerequisite success before dependent execution.
The runtime has validated hierarchy, dependency identities, and cycles before this review.
leaf_prerequisites gives the resolved graph, including story and ancestor dependencies. Read its actual edges before claiming a missing prerequisite.
Criteria describe future outcomes. Their prerequisites do not need to be accepted before initial plan review.
The selector requires their independent certificates before dependent dispatch.
project_initial_observation supplies the original inventory baseline. original_observation supplies current retained world state.
An inventory threshold of twenty from an empty baseline satisfies twenty additional items at that leaf's verification time.
Accepted inventory attainment does not require the collected items to remain after crafting consumes them.
current_site_survey.recipes contains original recipe lookups with ingredient counts and output_count.
Use these counts for arithmetic. Do not invent a crafting ratio or infer a resource shortfall from an empty starting inventory before gathering.
current_site_survey.tool_contracts supplies the actual recipe-search, smelting, and eating schemas.
Recipe search lists craftable items. An iron-ingot crafting recipe does not describe smelting raw iron.
The smelting leaf must use the smelt tool and prove its actual consumed input and resulting ingots.
A not_found recipe for a requested name requires revision of that name or method. It does not require the operator to repeat the same lookup.
Do not ask for a crafting grid or recipe list already supplied in the current survey.
Require observable usability conditions when the goal asks for a usable structure.
Check entry and exit coordinates against the actual floor and wall bounds.
A house entry belongs inside the clear interior; its exit belongs outside the outer footprint beside the door approach.
An interior corner cannot establish exit, regardless of its description.
Reject invented resource observations or unsupported starting assumptions.
The player is an entity, not a block. A body can occupy air cells. Recovery landing checks need floor, feet, and head cells.
Nearby-block summaries can include buried ore. An empty exposed-region result or an inspection with no exposed_faces cannot establish exposed ore.
When the location is unknown, a feasible exposed-search method can precede mining; a guessed confirmed ore location cannot.
The current_site_survey contains original read-only inspections of proposed physical cells and regions.
Read those facts before requesting terrain information. Future construction conditions normally do not hold yet.
Exact cell inspections establish the named cells. A nearby-block summary cannot prove that a surveyed structure is absent.
Evaluate observed names against the condition's allowed names. Dirt can satisfy a solid-foundation condition that permits dirt.
An existing correct structure can be retained, repaired, and independently verified in a new task.
Do not require it to be built again from an empty world.
Respect a requested site and its explicit distance bound. Do not invent a tighter location constraint.
Use the named starting point for that bound. A body's later movement does not move the requested site.
An explicit preparation leaf can establish them before dependent building work.
Do not ask the operator for a grid already present in these observations.
For incorrect criteria, missing acceptance coverage, or unsupported assumptions, return revise.
Revision can repair acceptance conditions. Refinement preserves them while splitting oversized work.
When a leaf combines separate gathering, crafting, construction, and usability outcomes, request refinement of that leaf.
Tool-call count alone does not make a leaf oversized.
Select one target_id for controlled refinement.
Accept a tree whose leaves express meaningful outcomes and whose criteria cover the request.
Use waiting for missing user intent, configuration, or unavailable external evidence that this workflow cannot obtain.
For repairable names, criteria, and methods, use revise with the actual missing fact or mismatch.
When a real blocker prevents a feasible plan, return blocked.

To inspect an original source, set evidence_requests with its catalog source ID and numbered line window or query. Read evidence_index to find original source IDs when the selected contract does not supply their names. That response requests retrieval only; no plan or acceptance from it is committed. After retrieval, return your final decision with evidence_requests empty.

native_review.summary: The 'save_tested' leaf criteria are insufficient to verify the goal's requirement for a 'tested return route'. The current criteria only check if the body is near the initial spawn (st_spawn) and alive (st_alive). They do not verify that a route was actually saved using `minecraft_remember(kind='routes')` as instructed, nor do they confirm the specific sequence of observations (home -> outside -> home) required to establish the tested nature of the route. Additionally, the instruction mentions saving the home location at the house entrance, but there is no criterion verifying the home location itself or the successful execution of the save command. To accept this leaf, it needs criteria that explicitly verify the existence of the saved route data or the completion of the observation sequence described in the instruction.
